product_one_liner.value: Syren provides data and AI solutions—including agentic AI, data engineering, data science, and supply-chain optimization—for enterprises across industries such as retail, CPG, healthcare, manufacturing, and financial services.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as a data and AI adoption partner and a supply-chain optimization provider.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer include no pricing link; the site directs prospects to contact Syren.

named_customers.notes: The case-studies index uses anonymized descriptions (for example, “Beverage leader” and “Leading retailer”) rather than naming at least two customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 392 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Syren identifies its headquarters as Bellevue, Washington; it also lists offices in India and Canada.

founded_year.notes: The company's license agreement states that Syren was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is a general insights/marketing blog. Although it includes some technical topics, the visible Software Engineering category shows only one post, and the index does not establish at least two product-build posts authored by engineers.

public_docs.notes: No public product documentation, developer portal, or help-center link appears in the homepage navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page links to a job portal but lists no individual current roles; no AI/ML/data-science posting is shown.

model_provider.notes: The public blog and privacy policy discuss models or third-party processing in general but do not identify a model provider that Syren's product publicly says it uses.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed privacy/legal pages do not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes Syren as unfunded and reports no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports the company as unfunded, so there is no reported round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page links to a job portal but displays no individual current postings, including no SDR, BDR, or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: A June 9, 2026 post announces Syren Sales Journey AI, within the six-month period preceding 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently complete team roster or dated leadership-change announcement was found to establish whether a C-level or VP-level person joined or left during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable partnerships/integrations and careers pages name data platforms and related tools but do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system Syren visibly uses.
